segments.caption: A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively climbing and shifting its position among the branches. It looks around, then raises its head and opens its mouth as if vocalizing or reacting to something, all while surrounded by fresh green blossoms with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively foraging for food. It stands on its hind legs, reaching up with its paws to grasp and pull down branches, then lowers its head to eat the green, clustered blossoms. The scene is set against the backdrop of a multi-story building, highlighting the unusual juxtaposition of wildlife in an urban environment.

A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively feeding on the fresh green blossoms. It shifts its position, using its powerful paws to grip the branches as it moves and eats, its head bobbing as it consumes the flowers. The scene is set in an urban environment, with a building visible in the background, highlighting the surprising juxtaposition of wildlife in a city setting.
A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively eating the fresh, green blossoms from the branches, with buildings visible in the background.
A brown bear is perched high in a tree with fresh green blossoms, using its front paws to hold onto branches as it intently eats the flowers, with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is seen actively climbing and navigating through the branches of a leafy tree, with a modern building visible in the background. The bear moves deliberately through the foliage, shifting its position and orientation as it ascends or explores the tree, showcasing its agility and natural climbing ability.
A brown bear is seen climbing and perching in a leafy, blossoming tree, with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively foraging by pulling down and eating the green, catkin-like blossoms from the branches. The bear is seen in various positions as it navigates the branches, its head lowered to consume the foliage. The scene is set in a naturalistic enclosure, with a river and a building visible in the background, indicating the bear is likely in a zoo or wildlife park.
A brown bear is seen climbing and maneuvering through the branches of a leafy tree near a river, with a building visible in the background.
Two bears are seen climbing and maneuvering through the branches of a leafy tree near a river, with one bear actively climbing upwards while the other remains partially obscured among the foliage.

A family of brown bears is actively climbing a leafy tree near a river, with cubs scrambling up the trunk and branches while an adult bear is perched higher up, all set against a backdrop of water and onlookers.
Three brown bears are seen climbing and perching in a leafy tree beside a river, with a crowd of onlookers gathered on a viewing platform below, observing the scene.

Two young brown bears are seen climbing a tree trunk in a zoo or wildlife park enclosure, with one bear positioned higher than the other. Below them, a glass-bottomed walkway allows visitors to observe the animals, and their reflections are visible in the calm water beneath. The scene is set on a sunny day with lush green foliage, capturing the bears’ natural climbing behavior as they ascend the tree while being watched by onlookers.
Two young brown bears interact near a tree trunk in a grassy enclosure beside a body of water; one climbs the tree while the other sits at its base, and they eventually meet and nuzzle each other.

Two young brown bears are seen interacting playfully and affectionately near the base of a tree in a sunlit, grassy, and wooded area. One bear, appearing slightly smaller, nuzzles and rubs against the other, which is resting or sitting. The smaller bear then moves around the larger one, and they both eventually begin to walk away together, maintaining close proximity, suggesting a strong social bond.
A mother brown bear and her cub walk side-by-side across a grassy, sun-dappled clearing, moving steadily from left to right as the cub stays close to its mother’s side.
